title: Alleged Offer For Sale Of Mauser Pistols By Chinese Constable Of French Police

page_data.en:
CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ____
S.2 Special Branch Station
REPORT
Date November 16 1937.
Alleged offer for sale of Mauser pistols by a Chinese
Constable of French Police.
Made by ________ and Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao Liang.

About 11 a.m. this date Mr. Hsu Tieh-yung (許鐵庸),
second son of Mr. Hsu Yuen, ex-Commissioner of Foreign Affairs
in Shanghai, called at Police Headquarters and volunteered the
following statement :-
"I have been approached by a Chinese policeman No.530
(? the exact number I cannot remember) of the French Police
at Lo Ka Wan Station who came to my house at 171 Route
Stanislas Chevalier and offered for sale four Mausers at
$70 each, one of the pistols being produced at the house,
bearing the stamp of the Police Bureau.
"The constable stated that other policemen of the
French Police had picked up machine guns as well. If I did
not want them, he would try Mr. Koo Sz (顧四), theatre
proprietor and ricsha hong owner, who was once arrested in
connection with the murder of Dong Chia-pang".
Mr. Hsu repeated the above statement when he was
brought before Chief Inspector Ross.

Tan Shao Liang
Superintendent.

D. C. (Special Branch)
DC (C-)
Will you take up
M. Tolez. Omit name

(印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE 17 NOV 1937 SPECIAL BRANCH)
17 NOV 1937    Deputy Commr (SPECIAL BRANCH)
